groups.title: COPD
groups.body: A 58-year-old man with a 30-year smoking history reports six months of progressive breathlessness and a daily productive cough. Spirometry: FEV1/FVC 0.58, with no improvement after a bronchodilator.

questions.text: Which cellular adaptation is most likely in this patient's bronchial epithelium?
questions.explanation: Chronic smoke injury replaces ciliated columnar epithelium with squamous epithelium.

questions.text: The same patient now has recurrent chest infections. Which cell type would predominate in a bronchial biopsy?
questions.explanation: Chronic inflammation is dominated by lymphocytes and macrophages.
